scenarios.title: Language Change Mid-Conversation
scenarios.description: Patient begins in Tamil, switches to Hindi, then concludes in English.

turns.asha_response: புரிந்தது, உங்களுக்கு தாகமாக உள்ளது மற்றும் தண்ணீர் வேண்டும். உடனே தண்ணீர் கொண்டுவரச் சொல்கிறேன்.

turns.user_utterance: और मुझे बहुत थकान भी महसूस हो रही है।
turns.asha_response: मुझे समझ आ रहा है कि आज आपको बहुत थकान और कमजोरी महसूस हो रही है. कृपया आराम से बैठिए.

turns.user_utterance: Can I please just rest here?
turns.asha_response: I understand that you are feeling very tired and drained today. Please sit down and rest comfortably. You do not have to exert yourself.

scenarios.title: Speech Self-Correction & Repair
scenarios.description: Patient changes mind mid-sentence or in the subsequent turn.

turns.user_utterance: Bring me water... no wait, don't bring water.
turns.asha_response: I understand clearly that you do not want water right now. I will not bring any. Please rest comfortably.

turns.user_utterance: Actually, my stomach is hurting now.
turns.asha_response: I hear that you are experiencing pain and discomfort. I am immediately notifying your caregiver so they can come check on you and make you comfortable.

scenarios.title: Repetition & Perseveration
scenarios.description: Patient repeats the same question or phrase due to short-term memory lapse.

turns.user_utterance: Where am I, who are you?
turns.asha_response: Everything is alright. You are safe at home in your comfortable room. I am here with you, and your caregiver is close by.

turns.user_utterance: Where am I? What place is this?
turns.asha_response: Everything is alright. You are safe at home in your comfortable room. I am here with you, and your caregiver is close by.

scenarios.title: Incomplete Answer & Anomia Recovery
scenarios.description: Patient trails off, ASHA clarifies, patient completes thought in next turn.

turns.asha_response: I want to be sure I understand you properly. Could you please say that once more gently?
I understand you are thirsty and need water. I am notifying your caregiver to bring you a fresh glass right away.

scenarios.title: Synonym Evolution Across Turns
scenarios.description: Patient describes physical state using colloquial idioms rather than standard terms.

turns.asha_response: मैं समझ गई कि आपको प्यास लगी है और पानी चाहिए. मैं आपकी देखभाल करने वाले को तुरंत पानी लाने के लिए कहती हूँ.
मुझे समझ आ रहा है कि आज आपको बहुत थकान और कमजोरी महसूस हो रही है. कृपया आराम से बैठिए.

scenarios.title: Contradictory Information
scenarios.description: Patient says they want to walk, then immediately forbids walking.

turns.asha_response: It is a wonderful time for your gentle walk. Let's make sure you have your comfortable footwear on first.

turns.user_utterance: No, do not make me walk, my legs ache!
turns.asha_response: I understand that you do not want to walk right now. That is completely okay. Please rest and take it easy.

scenarios.title: Circumlocution with Strict Safety Guard
scenarios.description: Patient forgets pill name, describes appearance; ASHA refuses to guess drug.

turns.user_utterance: Where is that small white round tablet the doctor gave me?
turns.asha_response: I hear you describing a pill by its shape or color. For your medical safety, I cannot guess or identify medicines by their appearance. I have alerted your family caregiver to assist you directly.

scenarios.title: Explicit Refusal of Assistance
scenarios.description: Patient explicitly states they do not want help.

turns.user_utterance: Asha, leave me alone, I do not need your help.
turns.asha_response: I understand you would like to manage on your own. I respect that completely. I will be right here quietly if you need anything at all.
